notes.title: GCS: Salvage Rat is Now Live!
notes.notes: [p]After years of work and plenty of prayer [i]GCS: Salvage Rat[/i] is officially released into the wild.[/p][p]This project started as a dream. It became a daily grind. And now, it's in your hands. Whether you're here to dive into asteroid belts, uncover ancient wrecks, or just tinker with modules until something explodes — thank you for being part of this.[/p][p][/p][p]Please be sure to drop by the Discord server and to check the message boards for additional information![/p]

notes.title: Final Stretch and Price Reveal
notes.notes: [p]One of the most common questions has been about the price. So here it is:[/p][p][/p][p][b][i]GCS: Salvage Rat[/i][/b] will launch at [b]$9.99 USD[/b].[/p][p]No microtransactions. No deluxe editions. Just one game, one price.[/p][p][/p][p]The trailer is now live. If you've been waiting to see more, now’s the time.[/p][p][/p][p]Thanks for all the support.[/p]

notes.title: Status Update – June 2025
notes.notes: [p]Greetings![/p][p][/p][p]It's been a little while since the last update, but development has been moving steadily behind the scenes. With release just a couple months away, the focus lately has been on refining what's there, tightening up gameplay, and making sure things feel solid.[/p][p]Every part of the game, from core systems to level design, has seen meaningful progress. It's shaping up into something gritty, tense, and (hopefully) memorable.[/p][p]A proper trailer is in the works now and should be ready in the coming weeks. We're looking forward to showing off more of the world, the tone, and what the game's really about.[/p][p]Thanks again to everyone who's followed along, wishlisted, or reached out with support. We're getting close...[/p]

notes.title: Salvage Crew Recruitment: Beta Test Starts Soon
notes.notes:
🛠️ [b]The Void Awaits: Beta Testers Needed[/b] 🛠️

Before the stars align, we need a few tough salvagers to forge the path.

We’re opening a private beta for [b]GCS: Salvage Rat[/b], and we’re looking for 5 players ready to dive into the unknown.
You’ll get access to the early build — raw, unpolished, and full of dangers — and your feedback will help shape the final journey. As a thanks, you'll get to keep your copy for life.

[b]Beta Launch[/b]: Targeting first week of May
Here's what we need from you:
[list]
[*]     [b]Explore without fear.[/b]
[*]     [b]Push the systems, find the cracks.[/b]
[*]     [b]Report bugs, balance issues, and anything that feels off.[/b]
[*]     [b]Understand: this isn’t a sightseeing tour — it’s salvage, and it’s messy.[/b]
[/list]
[b]How to Apply[/b]:
Join the Discord server, and enter the word 'BETA' in the #general channel https://discord.gg/fHAcfgUPVF

Upon first completion of 5 registered testers or May 8, testing will begin.

. . . . . . . . . . . . . . . . .

Few will answer. Fewer will endure.
